moodys.citation_text: Centura's debt was historically issued through CommonSpirit Health and AdventHealth obligated groups; no standalone Centura senior public credit rating surfaced.

sp.citation_text: Standalone Centura S&P rating not surfaced.

fitch.citation_text: Standalone Centura Fitch rating not surfaced.

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: Centura Health joint venture dissolved; assets split between CommonSpirit (20 hospitals CO/KS) and AdventHealth (5 hospitals CO).
rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Strategic dissolution after 27 years; Centura had $7.5M loss in 2020.
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Centura fold finalized; CommonSpirit and AdventHealth divvy up hospital portfolio (Aug 1, 2023).

moodys.citation_text: Centura ceased to exist as a JV; any standalone rating withdrawn upon dissolution.

outcome_class_rationale: Centura had no standalone public credit rating from major agencies; debt sat at parent levels (CommonSpirit and AdventHealth). Entity dissolved Aug 2023. Outcome class cannot be cleanly applied. Note CommonSpirit (A-/Baa1/A-) and AdventHealth (AA/Aa2/AA) absorbed assets.
_notes: Per user instructions: multi-system entity. Real economic exposure resides at CommonSpirit and AdventHealth, which are tracked separately. Centura itself is essentially N/A for ratings tracking purposes.
